leadIn: By the end of this lesson, learners will be able to:
objectives: Apply React.memo to wrap a functional component for performance optimization.
Implement a memoized component that accepts props and returns JSX elements.
Use TypeScript generics to define prop types for a memoized component.
Construct a comparison function to control when a memoized component should re-render.
Execute conditional logic within the comparison function to compare previous and next props.
Define a custom comparison function that returns true when props are equal to prevent re-renders.
Utilize React.memo with a custom comparison function to optimize component rendering.
Control component re-renders by implementing shallow prop comparisons.
Invoke React.memo on a component that receives primitive and object props.
Apply React.memo to a component that renders conditionally based on prop values.
Implement memoization for components that receive callback functions as props.
Use React.memo to prevent unnecessary re-renders in a parent-child component hierarchy.
